title: Add prompt and instruction quality gate
measurement_note: Timing is estimated from web-first intake, memory bootstrap, edit, and validation milestones after the user request.

phases.label: Web-first intake
phases.bottleneck_notes: Checked official prompt guidance, NIST bias/GenAI risk materials, and Stanford language modeling material.

phases.label: Memory and structure review
phases.bottleneck_notes: Reviewed existing AI usage gap profile, operating docs, persistent instructions, requirements baseline, prompt router, and memory bootstrap anchors.

phases.label: Rule and artifact implementation
phases.bottleneck_notes: Cross-cutting governance edits touched settings, operating docs, workflows, prompts, requirements, specs, and history records.

phases.label: Verification
phases.bottleneck_notes: Ran JSON, config contract, memory bootstrap, docs, naming, structure, map, task-board, governance health, grounding, evaluator, work-timer, and diff whitespace checks.

bottleneck_analysis.interpretation: The slowest step is not the wording update itself but keeping the durable rule discoverable across config, docs, requirements, specs, memory, and history.
improvement_candidates: If prompt instruction quality checks repeat often, add a small deterministic prompt-brief validator.
Add more before/after examples after real user instructions accumulate.
